main.remarks: This item contains instructions to arrange, build, launch, or prepare artifacts, environments, laboratories, or tools.

method.name: TryPrepareContentIntegrityState
method.summary: Prepare a content digest only when the MSBuild item has content to protect.
method.param: Receives the current content digest when eligible.
method.returns: True when content or streamed content is present.

method.name: CaptureContentMutationMemento_NoSync
method.summary: Capture the MSBuild payload, requirements, and sequence references for rollback of a rejected content update.
method.remarks: The memento restores Content, Requirements, and Sequence references; DataItemStateSnapshot restores shared protection and integrity state.
method.returns: Memento for the current MSBuild payload.

method.name: CaptureContentIntegritySnapshot_NoSync
method.summary: Capture the MSBuildItem content projection used by canonical content-integrity hashing.
method.remarks: Includes content, unordered Requirements membership, and Sequence entries in key order with their integer keys. Encrypted items use their stored encrypted payload bytes.

method.name: RefreshContentIntegrityState_NoSync
method.summary: Refresh or clear the content-integrity hash and synchronize the corresponding assertion state.
method.param: Security context used to apply the content assertion state.
method.returns: True when the hash update and assertion-state application both succeed.
method.remarks: Content is considered present when the item is streamed, has a content value, or has at least one Requirement or Sequence entry. Clears the content hash and assertion if either update or assertion-state application fails. Does not acquire synchronization; callers must hold the item's data gate.

method.name: RefreshContentIntegrityStateAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously refresh or clear the content-integrity hash and synchronize the corresponding assertion state.
method.param: Security context used to apply the content assertion state.
Token forwarded to the content-integrity hash update.
method.returns: True when the hash update and assertion-state application both succeed.
method.remarks: Content is considered present when the item is streamed, has a content value, or has at least one Requirement or Sequence entry. Clears the content hash and assertion if either update or assertion-state application fails. Does not acquire synchronization; callers must hold the item's data gate. Exceptions that escape the hash update propagate to the caller.

content.name: Content
content.summary: Build Runner Entry Point | MSBuild Project/Solution File | Production Script.

method.name: op_Inequality
method.returns: True if MSBuildItems are not equal.

method.name: GetContent
method.remarks: Returns resident content without checking streamed mode or reading the file. Use GetContentStream for streamed content.

method.name: SetContent
method.returns: Returns true if Content was set successfully.

method.name: SetRequirements
method.param: The security context to use for encryption and assertion creation.
method.returns: True if Requirements was set successfully.

method.name: SetSequence
method.param: The security context to use for encryption and assertion creation.
method.returns: Returns true if Sequence was set successfully.

method.name: CloneRequirementsAsync
method.summary: Clone the requirement set for isolated read and decrypt flows.
method.returns: A cloned requirement set, or null when the input is null or cloning fails.

method.name: CloneSequenceAsync
method.summary: Clone the ordered build sequence for isolated read and decrypt flows.
method.returns: A cloned sequence, or null when the input is null or any step cannot be cloned.

method.name: WipeDataInMemoryOnly
method.summary: Securely erases only the in-memory plaintext data fields.
method.returns: True if the data was successfully zeroed; otherwise, false.
method.remarks: Does not affect encrypted data or file-based content.
